```{r}
library(data.table)

find_repo_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  current <- normalizePath(start, mustWork = TRUE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(current, "TransferSemi", "DESCRIPTION")) &&
        dir.exists(file.path(current, "visualization_github"))) return(current)
    parent <- dirname(current)
    if (identical(parent, current)) break
    current <- parent
  }
  stop("Cannot locate the repository root.", call. = FALSE)
}
repo_root <- find_repo_root()
BASE <- file.path(repo_root, "semi-transfer-learning")
figure_dir <- file.path(repo_root, "outputs", "figures", "time_visualize")
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dims <- c(8, 20)
ns <- c(100, 200)
simis <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)
lambda_length <- 100L

methods <- c("Late Fusion", "Late Fusion with Nuisance")

colors <- c(
"Late Fusion" = "#7CFC00",          # bright lawn green
"Late Fusion with Nuisance" = "#2ECC71"   # bright emerald green
)


# ---------- load raw seed-level times (best for boxplots) ----------
all_rows <- list()
# --------------------------
# Load data (seed-averaged per simi)
# --------------------------
rows <- list()
for (dim in dims) {
  root <- file.path(BASE, sprintf("time_6_dim%d", dim))
  for (n in ns) {
    for (simi in simis) {
      folder <- file.path(
        root,
        sprintf("_n_%d_simi_%slambda_len%d", n, format(simi, nsmall = 1), lambda_length)
      )
      if (!dir.exists(folder)) next

      files <- list.files(folder, pattern = "^time_data_seed_.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
      if (length(files) == 0) next

      for (f in files) {
        dt <- fread(f)
        all_rows[[length(all_rows)+1]] <- data.table(
          dim = dim,
          n = n,
          similarity = simi,
          Method = "Late Fusion",
          Value = as.numeric(dt$time_para_transfer[1])
        )
        all_rows[[length(all_rows)+1]] <- data.table(
          dim = dim,
          n = n,
          similarity = simi,
          Method = "Late Fusion with Nuisance",
          Value = as.numeric(dt$time_nonpar_transfer[1])
        )
      }
    }
  }
}
all_data <- rbindlist(all_rows, fill = TRUE)
if (nrow(all_data) == 0L) {
  stop(
    "No lambda_len100 timing inputs were found under semi-transfer-learning/time_6_dim8 or time_6_dim20.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

# ---- convert seconds → minutes ----
all_data[, Value := Value / 60]

all_data[, `:=`(
  n = factor(n, levels = ns),
  similarity = factor(similarity, levels = simis),
  Method = factor(Method, levels = names(colors))
)]

library(ggplot2)

custom_labeller2 <- labeller(
  n = function(x) paste0("n=", x),
  dim = function(x) paste0("dim=", x)
)

p <- ggplot(all_data, aes(x = Method, y = Value, fill = Method)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, coef = 2) +
  facet_grid(n ~ dim, labeller = custom_labeller2, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Method", y = "Time (minutes)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(figure_dir, "time_visualize_minutes.pdf"),
  plot = p,
  width = 10, height = 8,
  dpi = 300
)

p

```


```{r}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

# all_data already created in your code:
# columns: dim, n, similarity (factor), Method (factor), Value

# make sure similarity is ordered 0.0..1.0
all_data[, similarity := factor(similarity, levels = simis)]
all_data[, Method := factor(Method, levels = names(colors))]
all_data[, n := factor(n, levels = ns)]
all_data[, dim := factor(dim, levels = dims)]

custom_labeller2 <- labeller(
  n = function(x) paste0("n=", x),
  dim = function(x) paste0("dim=", x)
)
library(data.table)

summary_data <- all_data[, .(
  log_mean = mean(log(Value)),
  log_se   = sd(log(Value))/sqrt(.N)
), by = .(dim, n, similarity, Method)]

summary_data[, `:=`(
  mean = exp(log_mean),
  ymin = exp(log_mean - 1.96*log_se),
  ymax = exp(log_mean + 1.96*log_se)
)]
# log scale cannot plot <=0
summary_data[ymin <= 0, ymin := min(mean) * 0.5]
baseline <- min(summary_data$ymin[is.finite(summary_data$ymin) & summary_data$ymin > 0]) * 0.8
summary_data[, base := baseline]

p_simi_bar_like <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x = similarity, y = mean, color = Method)) +
  geom_linerange(
    aes(ymin = base, ymax = mean),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
    linewidth = 8,   # thickness = looks like a bar
    lineend = "butt"
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
    width = 0.25,
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  facet_grid(dim ~ n, labeller = custom_labeller2, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Similarity", y = "Time (minutes)") +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

p_simi_bar_like
ggsave(
  file.path(figure_dir, "time_visualize_by_similarity_bar_ci.pdf"),
  p_simi_bar_like,
  width = 12, height = 8,
  dpi = 300
)

p_simi_bar_like
```

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

# ensure factors are ordered as you had
all_data[, similarity := factor(similarity, levels = simis)]
all_data[, Method := factor(Method, levels = names(colors))]
all_data[, n := factor(n, levels = ns)]
all_data[, dim := factor(dim, levels = dims)]

custom_labeller2 <- labeller(
  n = function(x) paste0("n=", x),
  dim = function(x) paste0("dim=", x)
)

# mean bar + 95% CI errorbar
p_simi_bar <- ggplot(all_data, aes(x = similarity, y = Value, fill = Method)) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "col",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    width = 0.65
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_cl_normal,
    geom = "errorbar",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    width = 0.25
  ) +
  facet_grid(dim ~ n, labeller = custom_labeller2, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Similarity", y = "Time (minutes)") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, NA),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) + scale_y_log10(
  limits = c(0.01, NA)
) 
ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, "time_visualize_for_PLM_bar_ci.pdf"), p_simi_bar, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
p_simi_bar
```
